name: QUAX
summary: The Italian QUAX program includes conventional axion–photon cavity searches and ferromagnetic haloscopes using electron spins in magnetic materials.
detection_principle: Axion–photon coupling produces microwaves in a cavity; the ferromagnetic branch searches for hybrid magnon–photon signals from axion–electron-spin interactions.

status.label: Multiphase project: completed experiments alongside further construction / design
status.evidence: 2024 sources support the phase recorded here, rather than a real-time status of the entire project as of the access date.

timeline.event: Search for axion dark matter with the QUAX–LNF tunable haloscope

collaboration.name: QUAX Collaboration / project team

key_parameters.name: QUAX-LNF 2024
key_parameters.value: 8 T field; copper cavity at approximately 30 mK; 8.831496–8.83803 GHz

results.summary: The LNF scan found no significant excess; the published version gives a best coupling limit of 0.882×10⁻¹³ GeV⁻¹ at 90% CL.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
